snippet.title: Little Nemo - PC Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Little Nemo will be arriving on Steam (and itch.io) on March 31, but you'll be able to play the demo this month in Steam Next Fest.

Wislist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2074630/Little_Nemo_and_the_Guardians_of_Slumberland/

And keep an eye out for announcements about the Nintendo Switch release date later this year!
